messages:
maya: observed spike in provisional token charges during canary for streaming toolcall path. lots of 1-3 token provisional entries on reconnects.

oliver: can you share sample logs? is this the sidecar or router doing new session ids?

maya: router ends up issuing new session id when ALB probe reconnects. backend treats it as fresh stream -> charges prefix tokens. sample:
```
[2026-05-10T07:14:02Z] session=start-aaa reconnect prev=start-zzz route=canary path=/v1/toolcall provisional=2
```

ops-bot: alert CREATED-STREAM-1234

oliver: we've seen similar ghost-prefix stuff. quick fixes: (A) propagate original-session header from router -> backend for dedupe OR (B) tag very-short sessions from known probe agents and exclude from billing.

maya: prefer dedupe by x-original-session-id so we keep audit trail. also console: we need to surface "probe-tagged provisional" metric.

console-team: can add a dashboard slice and a probe toggle for billing views. will add CONSOLE-311.

billing-team: caution on auto-exclude. need CSV export of flagged provisional groups for manual review before auto refunds.

oliver: plan: router patch to emit x-original-session-id when reconnect detected; backend to collapse provisional when original id matches recent tombstone window; ledger to keep provisional rows but include tag metadata. reconcile job will auto-refund low-confirmation probe cohorts after 24h if pass rate <5%.

maya: I'll open infra PR and schedule canary. adding rollout gate: only enable auto-refund after sampler shows >90% of flagged sessions match probe UA/IP list.

ops-bot: created INFRA-900 and QA job q/reconnect-sim

oliver: thanks — include known mobile UA whitelist so we don't misclassify short legitimate clients.

maya: will do. followups in INFRA-900 and CONSOLE-311.
